svg.aria-label: Your book, alice.epub, becomes a chart with a bar per chapter: the first three are ready to read. Chapter four has words still to learn; one of them, curtsey, is learned with the book's own sentence, She tried to curtsey as she spoke, comes back after 1, 3, 7, 21 and 60 days, and chapter four fills up and becomes ready.
svg.text: Know the words before you read
Each word is learned with the book's own sentence.

g.text: She tried to curtsey as she spoke
